title: Answer
description:
God formerly spoke at many times and in many ways by prophets. He has now spoken in the Son.

That Son is heir of all things, and the One through whom the worlds were made. Creation and inheritance meet in one Person.

He is the brightness of God’s glory and the exact expression of His person. No prophet and no angel is given that.

He upholds all things by the word of His power. That is the same word by which all things were made, not a lesser word added later.

By Himself, on the cross, He purged sins, and that purging is complete. Then He sat down.

What remains is still ahead. He is to come back, defeat evil, and rule Israel. He is to put His Torah across the nations, and the nations are to come and worship Him. The rebellion is to be cleansed. Then He delivers the kingdom to the Father.
